App Store and Google Play publishing, ASO

Your app gets into the stores without rejections and shows up in search, and we help open developer accounts for an Uzbek company. An MVP in 1–2 weeks, from UZS 6 mln; the full version in 2–6 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

Timeline
MVP 1–2 weeksFull 2–6 weeks

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Guidance on developer accounts (D-U-N-S number, Apple and Google)
  • Store listings in three languages
  • Screenshots
  • Privacy forms
  • Submission and review handling
What the full version adds
  • Store keyword research (ASO)
  • A/B tests of store graphics
  • Rating prompts
  • Release management
  • Review monitoring
Please note

Store fees (Apple $99 a year, Google $25 once) are paid by your company.

What we need from you

  • The project's code and documents
  • Access rights
  • A contact person

Questions

What does “App Store and Google Play publishing, ASO” cost?
The MVP costs $500–1,500 (UZS 6–18.5 mln), the full version $2,000–6,000 (UZS 24–73 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “App Store and Google Play publishing, ASO” take?
The MVP takes 1–2 weeks, the full version 2–6 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
The project's code and documents, access rights, a contact person.
